journey.title: Engage. Convert. Support. Bring customers back.
paragraphs: From the first message to the next purchase, give customers help and keep your team in control.

stages.label: Engage
stages.title: Help every visitor find what they came for.
paragraphs: Your agent greets visitors, asks what they need and shows the right option, whether that is a product, a course or a service.

items.title: Asks what they need and suggests the right option
Shows photos, prices and details right in the chat
Greets visitors with questions they can tap
Offers help when a visitor looks stuck

stages.label: Convert
stages.title: Turn interest into bookings and orders.
paragraphs: Your agent answers questions, finds out what each person needs and books the appointment, visit or demo in the same chat.

items.title: Books appointments, visits and demos in your calendar
Asks the right questions to find serious customers
Adds products to the cart for online stores
Sends important enquiries to your team

stages.label: Support
stages.title: Give the right answer, by phone or chat.
paragraphs: Whether customers call or message you on WhatsApp, Instagram or your website, your AI agent answers from your business information. It checks connected tools for live details and brings in your team when more help is needed.

items.title: Answers questions by voice and in chat, at any hour
Uses your website, documents and FAQs for answers
Checks connected tools for live details, like order status
Opens support tickets and passes enquiries to your team

stages.label: Bring customers back
stages.title: Follow up on its own.
paragraphs: Send reminders, updates and offers at the right time. Your agent answers whoever replies, so a follow-up can turn into a sale or a booking.

items.title: Reminds shoppers about carts they left behind
Sends WhatsApp offers to one group, like past customers
Sends updates and reminders at the time you choose
Welcomes new customers and asks for reviews

team.title: See the conversations, customers and results in one place.
paragraphs: Your agent handles the routine work. Your team can see what happened and take over when needed.

items.title: One inbox for your customer messages
paragraphs: View website, WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger conversations together. Filter by channel or tag, and assign conversations to your team.

items.title: Customer details saved while your agent chats
paragraphs: Your agent saves each customer's name, email and request in the built-in CRM while it chats. Add the fields your business needs and tag contacts for follow-up. There is no limit on contacts, and if you already use HubSpot, you can connect it instead.

items.title: Human help with the conversation included
paragraphs: Your team can read the chat before taking over. On Instagram, replying from the app pauses the AI so it does not talk over you.

items.title: Know what customers ask and what works
paragraphs: See common questions, response times, leads and campaign results. For Shopify on WhatsApp, track orders and revenue from conversations and campaigns.

setup.title: Set it up for the way your business works.
paragraphs: Add your information, connect your tools and choose the jobs you want to automate. No coding needed.

items.title: Add your business information
paragraphs: Start with your website, FAQs or documents. Reuse shared information across your agents so updates are easier to manage.

items.title: Choose how your agent talks and acts
paragraphs: Set its name, tone and instructions. Decide which questions it can handle and when it should call in your team.

items.title: Connect your channels
paragraphs: Add your agent to your website, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and phone calls. One Meta login connects WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger.

items.title: Test it, then go live
paragraphs: Run test conversations and preview answers. When you’re happy, switch it on and your agent starts answering on every channel you connected.

items.title: Connect the tools you already use
paragraphs: Connect your store, calendar, CRM and knowledge sources to help your agent do the job.
Shopify | WooCommerce | Google Calendar | Calendly | HubSpot | Zendesk | Google Drive | Notion

paragraphs: Real businesses use Steps AI to answer their customers on WhatsApp, Instagram and their websites.

faq.title: A few answers before you book a demo.

items.title: Is Steps AI only for online stores?
paragraphs: No. You can use it for enquiries, appointments, lead capture and customer support across different businesses. Store integrations add product, checkout and order features for ecommerce.

items.title: Can it do more than reply to messages?
paragraphs: Yes. It can collect lead details, book appointments and create tickets. The platform also lets you run campaigns and build workflows for follow-up and other tasks.

items.title: How does it know about my business?
paragraphs: You add your website, FAQs and documents, then connect the tools it needs. The agent uses your information and instructions when it replies.

items.title: Can my team take over?
paragraphs: Yes. Your team can take over with the conversation history available. You can also set rules for when the agent should ask for human help.

items.title: How does the agent work across different channels?
paragraphs: Your agent uses your business information to help customers on your website, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and phone calls. Each channel offers different ways to connect: WhatsApp for messages and follow-ups, Instagram for DMs and comment replies, and the calling agent for voice conversations. Available actions depend on the channel and the tools you connect.

items.title: Do I need a developer?
paragraphs: You can set up your agent and build workflows without coding. The setup depends on the jobs, channels and tools you want to connect.
